headline: 10 deaths in 24 hours: Dengue toll hits deadliest day of the year in Bangladesh
summary: The death toll has risen to 281 as 1,996 more patients were hospitalised in a single day, according to the DGHS.
details: At least 10 dengue patients died in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00am today, marking the highest single-day death toll of the year.
According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), 1,996 others were hospitalised during the same period.

The deaths were distributed across several regions: three in Khulna division, two each in Barishal and Dhaka North City Corporation, and one each in Dhaka division, Dhaka South City Corporation, and Rajshahi division.
With these latest figures, the total number of dengue deaths this year has risen to 281, while total cases have reached 90,356.
Currently, 5,776 dengue patients are receiving treatment in hospitals across the country.
caption:
10 deaths in a single day. Bangladesh is facing its deadliest day of the year for dengue.

At least 10 dengue patients died in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00am today, marking the highest single-day death toll of the year.

According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), 1,996 others were hospitalised during the same period.

The deaths were distributed across several regions: three in Khulna division, two each in Barishal and Dhaka North City Corporation, and one each in Dhaka division, Dhaka South City Corporation, and Rajshahi division.

With these latest figures, the total number of dengue deaths this year has risen to 281, while total cases have reached 90,356.

Currently, 5,776 dengue patients are receiving treatment in hospitals across the country.

headline_marked: Murder suspect [[flees Dhaka court again]] after loosening handcuffs
headline: Murder suspect flees Dhaka court again after loosening handcuffs
summary: Shariful Islam, accused in a 2018 schoolboy's murder case, escaped from the dock today after previously fleeing police custody last year.
details: A murder case accused, Shariful Islam, 30, escaped from the dock of a Dhaka court today around 12:30 pm. He managed to loosen his handcuffs and flee the scene following a hearing by Dhaka Metropolitan Magistrate Md Jamshed Alam.
caption:
A murder suspect has escaped from a Dhaka court for the second time, loosening his handcuffs to flee the scene.

A murder case accused, Shariful Islam, 30, escaped from the dock of a Dhaka court today around 12:30 pm. He managed to loosen his handcuffs and flee the scene following a hearing by Dhaka Metropolitan Magistrate Md Jamshed Alam.
